title: The body of lintcrux waivers <project> --json and of the waivers tool
description: The waivers in force, read only: inline verilator lint_off ranges (pattern: lines a-b), lint_off lines of the Verilator configuration files the project names (pattern: the directive), and the findings frozen in the project's baseline (pattern: the finding's message; scope rebased onto this checkout). managed waivers are LintCrux Pro's; the open-core binary says with a licence.withheld warning that it left them out. file is reserved.
